name: Noise’s Halloween Bash
storyline: Sound the alarm! Halloween has arrived, and Noisette is hosting a party to celebrate the festivities! However, as she puts on the final touches, she realizes that she finds it difficult to immerse herself in the spooky atmosphere. So, she asks The Noise, surely a honourable and timely saint, to go out into the abandoned and speculatively haunted pumpkin patch to pick out the pumpkins needed to bring the vibes to the party!
summary: Play as The Noise in this one level fan-game, inspired by the Crash Bandicoot and Rayman franchises. Jump, slide, dash and bash through a 2.5D world while collecting pumpkins to save the Halloween festivities!
